title: Testing, Debugging & Quality Evidence
description: Verify expected outcomes with unit, integration, and user-flow tests; reproduce defects, investigate evidence, and validate AI-generated fixes.

lessons.title: Why testing matters
lessons.principle: Testing compares actual behavior with independently specified expectations and can reveal regressions.
lessons.practice: Write one normal, one boundary, and one invalid-input test for a function.

lessons.title: Test outcomes, not implementation trivia
lessons.principle: Tests tied to incidental internal names can break during a safe refactor.
lessons.practice: Assert the public result, error, or user-visible behavior unless an internal invariant is the intended contract.

lessons.title: Arrange, act, assert
lessons.principle: A clear test prepares context, executes one meaningful action, and checks observable results.
lessons.practice: Use simple named examples to document expected business rules.

lessons.title: Make assertions discriminating
lessons.principle: A test that only checks the code did not crash may pass despite the wrong result.
lessons.practice: Assert exact returned values, relevant state changes, and expected errors.

lessons.title: Unit testing
lessons.principle: Unit tests isolate a small behavior and should run quickly and deterministically.
lessons.practice: Test a task-title normalizer without network, DOM, or database access.

lessons.title: Use AI for case generation
lessons.principle: AI can propose edge cases but might accidentally mirror the same mistaken implementation.
lessons.practice: Derive expected results from requirements first and review every generated test oracle.

lessons.title: Integration testing
lessons.principle: Integration tests exercise contracts between components such as API handlers and persistence.
lessons.practice: Test that a valid create-task request produces a stored record and a matching response.

lessons.title: Exercise failure boundaries
lessons.principle: Mocking every integration can hide incorrect serialization and transaction behavior.
lessons.practice: Run at least one representative test using the real boundary or a faithful test dependency.

lessons.title: End-to-end and accessibility tests
lessons.principle: End-to-end tests exercise workflows through the user-facing application and can reveal wiring failures.
lessons.practice: Test add, reload, complete, and error feedback in the browser.

lessons.title: Do not equate snapshots with usability
lessons.principle: A screenshot cannot verify keyboard interaction, permissions, or actual persistence.
lessons.practice: Combine user-flow assertions with manual or automated keyboard and accessibility checks.

lessons.title: Reproduce before fixing
lessons.principle: A reproducible defect has clear setup, inputs, observed behavior, and expected behavior.
lessons.practice: Capture exact errors and the smallest failing case.

lessons.title: Create a regression test
lessons.principle: Fixes without tests may later be undone by unrelated code changes.
lessons.practice: Add a failing test for the root cause, confirm it fails before the fix, then verify it passes afterward.

lessons.title: Debugging with evidence
lessons.principle: Logs, stack traces, breakpoints, network requests, and stored state answer different diagnostic questions.
lessons.practice: Start at the earliest point where actual behavior diverges from expected behavior.

lessons.title: Do not patch symptoms blindly
lessons.principle: Suppressing an exception or adding retries may conceal corrupt data or an incorrect contract.
lessons.practice: Trace the input and call path until the first wrong assumption is identified.

lessons.title: Determinism and test isolation
lessons.principle: A reliable test controls time, randomness, network fixtures, and shared state where relevant.
lessons.practice: Reset mutated test data and avoid depending on execution order.

lessons.title: Investigate flaky failures
lessons.principle: An intermittently passing check may indicate concurrency, timing, external dependencies, or leaked state.
lessons.practice: Re-run the failing scenario and inspect isolation rather than simply increasing retry counts.

lessons.title: Regression and risk-based coverage
lessons.principle: Coverage metrics measure executed lines or branches, not whether important behavior was asserted.
lessons.practice: Prioritize high-impact permissions, data mutations, boundary cases, and compatibility.

lessons.title: Test adjacent behavior after AI edits
lessons.principle: A small-looking generated patch may alter shared helpers used by unrelated features.
lessons.practice: Run focused tests first, then broader checks that cover consumers of the changed code.

lessons.title: Final verification report
lessons.principle: A review should distinguish tests executed, tests unavailable, checks skipped, and residual risks.
lessons.practice: Report exact commands, environment, outcomes, and final commit being validated.

lessons.title: Avoid unsupported readiness claims
lessons.principle: A hypothetical test plan is not the same as an executed passing test suite.
lessons.practice: If checks cannot run, state why, provide a reproducible command, and leave readiness unconfirmed.

codeExamples.snippet:
# Reproduce on the intended final commit
git rev-parse HEAD
npm run check
# Record exit status, errors, and any unexecuted checks.
